def prepare_sampler(user_train: dict, itemnum: int):
    users = [u for u, items in user_train.items() if len(items) >= 2]
    if not users:
        raise ValueError("Training requires at least one user with two interactions")
    histories = {u: set(user_train[u]) for u in users}
    dense_pools = {}
    for u, observed in histories.items():
        if any(i < 1 or i > itemnum for i in observed):
            raise ValueError(f"Training item outside catalog for user {u}")
        if len(observed) >= itemnum:
            raise ValueError(f"User {u} has no eligible training negatives")
        if len(observed) > itemnum // 2:
            dense_pools[u] = [i for i in range(1, itemnum + 1) if i not in observed]
    return users, histories, dense_pools
